supporting_observations.claim: The account ext.rwong was created at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake, consistent with the alert's approximate time.
The domain-controller network logon for nora.blake came from WS-NBLAKE-01, and its logon ID matches the subject logon ID on the account-creation event.
The new account was added to the Freelancers group, matching the documented temporary-account practice.
The creator and group placement match the documented help-desk account-creation workflow; the available evidence does not indicate malicious activity related to this alert.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records establish the account creator's domain identity and logon context, but do not independently establish which person was at the workstation.
The account-creation and group-addition records show the Freelancers addition, but do not provide a complete view of the account's group memberships or subsequent activity.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish whether a specific request or approval existed for ext.rwong.
The records do not establish the new account's intended user or whether it was used after creation.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe was launched on WS-NBLAKE-01; the inventory says the organization has no VPN, but these records show process launch and a signed Cisco module, not a VPN connection. Track separately; this does not change the account-alert assessment. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
